Jonathan Youngblood
346-333-9390|jyoungb2@andrew.cmu.edu|LinkedIn
EDUCATION
Carnegie Mellon UniversityAug 2024 - May 2028
Bachelor of Science, Business, Additional Major in CS/AIPittsburgh, PA
Lone Star CollegeAug 2022 - May 2024
Associate’s, Business and Computer ScienceHouston, TX
EXPERIENCE
Mandel AIMay 2025 - Aug 2025
Founder’s Associate/InternSofia, BG
• 
Partnered with founders to drive operational strategy, identifying automation initiatives using Power Automate that 
improved reporting efficiency and enhanced KPI visibility across business units
• 
Conducted end-to-end process audits and applied data modeling to uncover scalability constraints and implement 
AI-enabled solutions that reduced manual analysis and improved operating leverage
• 
Presented product updates and strategic direction to enterprise clients (Neuralink, Apple), incorporating stakeholder 
feedback to strengthen client retention and long term value creation
United States SenateMar 2024 - May 2024
Public Policy InternHouston, TX
• 
Synthesized multi-source data and leveraged data modeling techniques to inform policy recommendations, ensuring 
analytical rigor and risk awareness in decision-making
• 
Built a structured tracking and reporting system using Power BI and basic coding to improve data integrity and enhance 
operational transparency
• 
Managed competing, time-sensitive priorities in a high-stakes environment by implementing automated scripts through 
basic coding for streamlined task scheduling and precision
PROJECTS
DEXA ScannerAug 2025 - Present
• 
Developing a full-stack Android application in Android Studio with integrated OCR to extract DEXA scan data, structure 
it in a database, and enable visualization in Power BI dashboards
• 
Implementing an AI chatbot using natural language processing to explain DEXA results and deliver personalized user 
feedback
• 
Now working on automating token cost reductions by building a custom lightweight language model in Python to process 
and communicate DEXA scan results instead of relying solely on external AI chatbot APIs
Frame-Level Speech RecognitionJan 2026 - Present
• 
Developed a deep learning–based frame level speech recognition system using MFCC features, training neural networks 
to classify phonemes from short time audio frames
• 
Designed and implemented a data processing pipeline in Python and SQL to stack variable-length speech recordings into 
a unified dataset, preserving frame-to-phoneme alignment for large-scale analysis
• 
Engineered context aware model inputs by incorporating temporal windows around each frame, improving phoneme 
classification by leveraging local speech context
TECHNICAL SKILLS
• 
Languages: Excel, Python, C/C++, R, Javascript, SQL
• 
Frameworks: PyTorch, NumPy, Pandas, React, Node.js
• 
Tools & Workflow: Git, Google Cloud Platform, VS Code, Android Studio, AWS, FireBase, Power BI, Power Automate
• 
Analytical Skills: Data Modeling, Basic Coding
CERTIFICATION
• 
Eagle Scout
• 
Microsoft Excel for Data Analysis
• 
Career Essentials in Data Analysis by Microsoft and LinkedIn

postings.title: Deep Learning for Medical Image Analysis
postings.overview: This project develops deep learning architectures for automated diagnosis from radiological images and targets publication-quality outcomes.
postings.studentRoleDescription: Implement and evaluate model pipelines, run experiments, and contribute to weekly research syncs.
postings.studentGain: Hands-on research publication experience and mentorship in modern ML workflows.
postings.requiredQualifications: Strong Python and machine learning fundamentals.

questions.question: Describe your experience with deep learning frameworks
What interests you most about this research area?

postings.title: Accessibility in Virtual Reality Environments
postings.overview: Investigating how to make VR experiences accessible to users with disabilities through user studies and prototype validation.
postings.studentRoleDescription: Support study design, prototype interaction flows, and analyze feedback data.
postings.studentGain: Experience in inclusive design research and mixed-method evaluation.
postings.requiredQualifications: Interest in HCI and accessibility, strong communication skills.

questions.question: Have you worked with VR development before?
Why are you interested in accessibility research?

postings.title: Multi-Robot Coordination for Warehouse Automation
postings.overview: Developing coordination algorithms for fleets of autonomous warehouse robots and validating in simulation and hardware.
postings.studentRoleDescription: Build coordination modules, run benchmark scenarios, and document experiment results.
postings.studentGain: Applied robotics systems experience in a production-style research environment.

questions.question: What robotics stack have you used in prior projects?
Describe a challenging debugging issue and how you resolved it.

postings.title: Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning for Scientific Text
postings.overview: Study parameter-efficient tuning methods for domain-specific scientific corpora and evaluate quality-cost tradeoffs.
postings.studentRoleDescription: Build training/evaluation scripts, run ablations, and summarize results in lab notes.
postings.studentGain: Practical experience with modern NLP pipelines and research experimentation.
postings.requiredQualifications: Python, basic deep learning, and data handling skills.
postings.preferredQualifications: Transformers experience and familiarity with Hugging Face.

questions.question: Describe your NLP project experience.
What would you measure to evaluate model quality?

postings.title: Adaptive Interfaces for First-Time Programmers
postings.overview: Design and test adaptive UI cues that help novices debug and understand code more effectively.
postings.studentRoleDescription: Prototype interaction patterns, run user studies, and clean/analyze usage logs.
postings.studentGain: Hands-on HCI study design and quantitative/qualitative analysis.
postings.requiredQualifications: Interest in education technology and UX research.

questions.question: How would you evaluate whether an interface helps learning?
Share one UX improvement idea for coding tools.

postings.title: SLAM Benchmarking in Indoor Dynamic Scenes
postings.overview: Benchmark modern SLAM stacks in dynamic indoor environments using custom datasets and metrics.
postings.studentRoleDescription: Run pipelines, instrument metrics, and document reproducible experiment protocols.
postings.studentGain: Experience with robotics evaluation and reproducibility best practices.
postings.requiredQualifications: Strong programming and systems debugging ability.

questions.question: What metrics matter for SLAM evaluation?
Describe a time you improved an experiment pipeline.

postings.title: Causal Inference for Campus Mobility Data
postings.overview: Apply causal inference techniques to understand interventions that improve campus transit efficiency.
postings.studentRoleDescription: Curate datasets, implement models, and create visual summaries for stakeholders.
postings.studentGain: Applied causal modeling and data storytelling skills.
postings.preferredQualifications: Prior work with causal inference libraries.

questions.question: What is one challenge in observational data analysis?
How would you communicate uncertainty to non-experts?

postings.title: Voice UI Usability in Noisy Environments
postings.overview: Investigate interaction breakdowns and design robust prompts for voice interfaces in realistic settings.
postings.studentRoleDescription: Prototype flows, recruit participants, and code usability sessions.
postings.studentGain: Real-world UX research and mixed-method analysis experience.
postings.requiredQualifications: Communication skills and curiosity about user behavior.

questions.question: What makes voice interfaces frustrating to users?
How would you structure a usability test?

postings.title: Low-Cost Manipulator Control for Lab Automation
postings.overview: Develop robust controllers for low-cost robotic arms in repetitive lab tasks.
postings.studentRoleDescription: Implement control loops, collect telemetry, and tune for robustness.
postings.studentGain: Practical robotics control and hardware integration skills.
postings.requiredQualifications: Control systems basics and strong coding skills.

questions.question: What is your approach to tuning controllers?
Describe experience with hardware debugging.

postings.title: Self-Supervised Learning for Satellite Imagery
postings.overview: Explore self-supervised representations for downstream land-use classification tasks.
postings.studentRoleDescription: Prepare geospatial datasets, train models, and benchmark transfer performance.
postings.studentGain: Computer vision research experience on real-world remote sensing data.
postings.preferredQualifications: Experience with PyTorch and geospatial tooling.

questions.question: What is self-supervised learning and why is it useful?
How would you evaluate representation quality?

postings.title: AI Tutor Feedback Timing Study
postings.overview: Analyze when AI-generated hints are most helpful for novice problem solving.
postings.studentRoleDescription: Instrument study prototypes, collect logs, and perform statistical comparisons.
postings.studentGain: Experimental design and product-oriented research skills.

questions.question: How would you define a useful hint?
What confounders would you watch for?

postings.title: Trajectory Planning Under Uncertainty
postings.overview: Investigate planning algorithms that maintain safety under uncertain sensing conditions.
postings.studentRoleDescription: Implement planners, evaluate safety metrics, and improve runtime performance.
postings.studentGain: Strong exposure to autonomous system planning pipelines.
postings.preferredQualifications: Motion planning libraries or robotics simulations.

questions.question: How do you think about safety in planning?
Describe your most complex algorithmic project.

postings.title: Fairness Auditing for Scholarship Recommendation Models
postings.overview: Build auditing pipelines to quantify and mitigate bias in recommendation systems.
postings.studentRoleDescription: Implement fairness metrics, run mitigation experiments, and report findings.
postings.studentGain: Practical ML fairness and responsible AI experience.
postings.requiredQualifications: Data analysis and machine learning basics.

questions.question: What fairness definition do you find most practical and why?
How would you present bias results to stakeholders?

postings.title: Cross-Cultural Interface Icon Comprehension
postings.overview: Study how icon metaphors are interpreted across cultural backgrounds and contexts.
postings.studentRoleDescription: Prepare study materials, coordinate participants, and synthesize outcomes.
postings.studentGain: End-to-end design research process experience.

questions.question: How would you avoid bias in participant recruitment?
What is one culturally specific UI assumption you have seen?

postings.title: Perception-Driven Grasp Planning
postings.overview: Use 3D perception to improve grasp success in cluttered tabletop scenes.
postings.studentRoleDescription: Develop grasp ranking features and evaluate success rates in simulation.
postings.studentGain: Perception + manipulation integration experience.
postings.preferredQualifications: 3D geometry or point cloud processing experience.

questions.question: What makes grasping hard in clutter?
How would you measure grasp planner quality?

postings.title: Streaming Pipelines for Campus Sensor Data
postings.overview: Build resilient real-time pipelines for ingesting and analyzing campus-wide sensor streams.
postings.studentRoleDescription: Implement ETL jobs, validate data quality, and optimize query performance.
postings.studentGain: Production-style data engineering and observability skills.
postings.preferredQualifications: Kafka/Spark or cloud data platform exposure.

questions.question: How do you detect data quality regressions?
What tradeoffs matter in streaming design?

postings.title: Attention Patterns in Multi-Panel Dashboards
postings.overview: Understand how users allocate attention across dense analytics dashboards.
postings.studentRoleDescription: Design tasks, analyze interaction logs, and produce actionable design guidance.
postings.studentGain: Cognitive UX research methods and analytics practice.
postings.requiredQualifications: Interest in cognition and interaction design.

questions.question: What signals indicate cognitive overload?
How would you compare two dashboard layouts?

postings.title: Energy Profiling for Mobile Robot Subsystems
postings.overview: Measure and optimize power consumption for sensing, planning, and actuation components.
postings.studentRoleDescription: Instrument subsystems, run profiling experiments, and recommend optimizations.
postings.studentGain: Embedded profiling and systems optimization experience.

questions.question: What is one technique for reducing power usage?
How would you design a repeatable profiling experiment?

postings.title: Multilingual Summarization for Technical Documents
postings.overview: Develop and evaluate summarization pipelines for multilingual technical writing.
postings.studentRoleDescription: Create evaluation datasets, tune models, and compare baseline systems.
postings.studentGain: NLP model evaluation and multilingual data handling experience.
postings.preferredQualifications: NLP coursework and model evaluation familiarity.

questions.question: How would you evaluate summary quality?
What challenges appear in multilingual NLP?

postings.title: Collaboration Friction in Hybrid Student Teams
postings.overview: Identify communication and workflow pain points in hybrid collaboration and test interventions.
postings.studentRoleDescription: Conduct interviews, code themes, and support intervention pilot studies.
postings.studentGain: Qualitative research rigor and stakeholder communication practice.
postings.preferredQualifications: Prior interview or thematic analysis experience.

questions.question: How would you ensure interview consistency?
What would make an intervention practical for students?
